lastResponse.text: Thanks for telling me. First, quick safety check: are you safe where you are right now, and do you need emergency help right this second? If yes, call nine one one now. If not, next step is call or text the main line: 3-6-0, 5-2-1, 6-5-2-7. Backup: 9-7-1, 3-1-9, 9-7-9-3. Tell them: “I’m 17 in Hillsboro, not safe at home, need youth shelter tonight.” They can route fast.
originalTexts: Thanks for telling me. First, quick safety check: are you safe where you are right now, and do you need emergency help right this second? If yes, call 911 now. If not, next step is call or text the main line: **3-6-0, 5-2-1, 6-5-2-7**. Backup: **9-7-1, 3-1-9, 9-7-9-3**. Tell them: “I’m 17 in Hillsboro, not safe at home, need youth shelter tonight.” They can route fast.
